Laboratory.value: Institut für Planetologie, University of Münster

Coupled Technique(s).cell: TIMS — Ba isotopes on a Thermo Scientific Triton Plus at the same institute; Hf-W on the same sample digestions

Target Material.cell: Chondrules, matrix separates and bulk rock of the Allende CV3 chondrite

value.member: matrix separates and bulk rock of the Allende CV3 chondrite

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Digestion aliquot — "All samples (0.3–0.5 g) were digested in closed Savillex beakers"; chondrule fractions "comprise between 155 and ~3000 chondrules each"

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Chondrule, matrix and bulk rock separates; preparation detailed in the supplementary material
Sample Preparation Method.value: Chondrule, matrix and bulk rock separates; preparation detailed in the supplementary material

Digestion Step.cell: 1: HF-HNO3 (-HClO4), closed Savillex beakers on a hotplate | 2: inverse aqua regia. Both steps stated; conditions not given beyond 'on a hotplate'.

value.member: closed Savillex beakers on a hotplate | 2: inverse aqua regia. Both steps stated
conditions not given beyond 'on a hotplate'.

Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.cell: 0.3–0.5 g digested; ~100 ng Mo consumed per measurement
Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.value: 0.3–0.5 g digested; ~100 ng Mo consumed per measurement

Chromatographic Separation Applied.cell: Yes — two-stage anion exchange for W, with Mo collected in 3 M HNO3 and further purified on Eichrom TRU Resin; Ba separated on AG50-X8

Isotope Dilution Spike.cell: N/A — no isotope dilution spike; mass bias handled by standard-sample bracketing or internal normalization

ICP-MS Type.cell: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]
ICP-MS Type.value: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: ⁹²Mo, ⁹⁴Mo, ⁹⁵Mo, ⁹⁶Mo, ⁹⁷Mo, ⁹⁸Mo, ¹⁰⁰Mo (Mo); ⁹¹Zr, ⁹⁹Ru (interference monitors, no target species) — "Isobaric interferences of Zr and Ru on Mo masses were corrected by monitoring 91Zr and 99Ru" (p.2); mass bias normalised to 98Mo/96Mo and ε⁹²/⁹⁴/⁹⁵/⁹⁷/¹⁰⁰Mo reported (pp.2–3)

Reported Variables and Units.cell: εiMo relative to the Alfa Aesar solution standard, εiMo = [(iMo/96Mo)sample/(iMo/96Mo)standard − 1] x 10^4

value.member: εiMo relative to the Alfa Aesar solution standard

Number of Cycles per Block.cell: 100 isotope ratio measurements, preceded by 40 baseline integrations

Baseline Measurement Approach.cell: 40 on-peak-zero baseline integrations of 8.4 s preceding each measurement
Baseline Measurement Approach.value: 40 on-peak-zero baseline integrations of 8.4 s preceding each measurement

Analysis Sequence.cell: Bracketing runs of the Alfa Aesar solution standard; BHVO-2 digestions "analyzed together with each set of samples"
Analysis Sequence.value: Bracketing runs of the Alfa Aesar solution standard; BHVO-2 digestions "analyzed together with each set of samples"

Internal Standard Element.cell: N/A — mass bias corrected by standard-sample bracketing, internal normalization or a double spike rather than by an added internal standard element

Internal Standard Concentration.cell: N/A — no added internal standard element

Mass Bias Correction Strategy.cell: Internal normalization to 98Mo/96Mo = 1.453173 using the exponential law, plus bracketing against the Alfa Aesar standard
Mass Bias Correction Strategy.value: Internal normalization to 98Mo/96Mo = 1.453173 using the exponential law, plus bracketing against the Alfa Aesar standard

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: Yes — Zr and Ru on Mo masses

Interfering Species.cell: Zr and Ru, monitored on 91Zr and 99Ru

Uncertainty Level.cell: 2 s.d. for external reproducibility (n = 24 for Mo, n = 14 for Ba)
Uncertainty Level.value: 2 s.d. for external reproducibility (n = 24 for Mo, n = 14 for Ba)

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially — "For samples analyzed several times, reported values represent the mean of pooled solution replicates". No acceptance or rejection rule stated

Combination Method.cell: all: mean of pooled solution replicates per sample; weighted average of recombined separates — 'For samples analyzed several times, reported values represent the mean of pooled solution replicates'; Table 1 notes b and c: 'Weighted average of C3m, C3n, C3i', 'Weighted average of C2, C3m, C3n, C3i, C4'

value.value: mean of pooled solution replicates per sample

Constants and Reference Values Used.cell: 98Mo/96Mo = 1.453173 for internal normalization; 134Ba/136Ba = 0.3078 (Carlson et al. 2007) for the TIMS half

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: BHVO-2, "several digestions of which were processed through the full analytical protocol and analyzed together with each set of samples"

Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical P.cell: External reproducibility from repeated BHVO-2 measurements: ±0.14 for ε97Mo to ±0.39 for ε92Mo (2 s.d., n = 24); Ba ±0.13 for ε135Ba to ±0.31 for ε138Ba (2 s.d., n = 14)

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: "The εiMo values obtained for BHVO-2 are indistinguishable from the Alfa Aesar standard, demonstrating that the Mo isotopic data are accurate"
